hooks.prompt: A git commit is about to be made. The tool input is: $ARGUMENTS. Read the commit message from the tool_input.command field. Check if the message follows conventional commits format (feat:, fix:, chore:, docs:, refactor:, test:, style:, ci:, perf:, build:, revert:). If it does, return {"ok": true}. If not, return {"ok": false, "reason": "Commit message must follow conventional commits format."}.

Read .claude/skills/doc-sync.md and execute its steps to verify unpushed changes are documented. Create a docs-only commit if needed. Return {"ok": true} if documentation is current (or was successfully updated), {"ok": false, "reason": "..."} if it cannot be completed. $ARGUMENTS
